title: Circus World Recalls Wireless Video Baby Monitors Due to Overheating Hazard
summary: Wiring in the baby monitor camera can overheat and emit smoke, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 800.

title: P. Graham Dunn Recalls Toy Rattles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The wooden dowels can be installed at an angle, allowing the metal rattle inside to become exposed. This poses a serious choking hazard to young children. Units: About 500.

title: Additional Reports of Fires and Low Consumer Response Rate Prompt Reannouncement of Goldstar and Comfort-Aire Dehumidifier Recall
summary: The power connector for the dehumidifier's compressor can short circuit, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 98,000 (previously recalled in December 2009).

title: Asurion Recalls Counterfeit BlackBerry-branded Batteries Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The counterfeit batteries can overheat, posing burn and fire hazards. Units: About 470,000.

title: Bosch Thermotechnology Recalls Boiler Survey Kits Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The use of a silver-colored gas pipe adapter included in the service kit can lead to gas leakage, posing a fire or explosion hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,500.

title: Belle Vanity Benches Sold Exclusively at Tuesday Morning Stores Recalled By LaMont Limited
summary: Legs on the Belle vanity bench can detach at the weld and allow the bench to collapse, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,900.

title: Fisher-Price Recalls Little People Play 'n Go Campsite™ Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The plastic Sonya Lee figure in the play set can break at the waist, exposing small parts that pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 96,000 in the United States (14,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Kawasaki Motors Corp. U.S.A. Recalls Off-Road Motorcycles Due to Injury Hazard
summary: A faulty housing for the ignition switch can allow water to enter and activate the electric starter unintentionally. This poses a serious hazard of injury or death. Units: About 4,000.

title: Bed Bath & Beyond Recalls Solar Lighted Cantilever Umbrellas Due to Injury Hazard
summary: A plastic connector which attaches to the arm of the umbrella can break, causing the umbrella to collapse. This poses a risk of injury to the user. Units: About 7,600.

title: Pottery Barn Kids Recalls to Repair Madeline Bunk Beds Due to Entrapment Hazard
summary: The end structure of the bunk bed can pose an entrapment hazard to young children, a violation of the Safety Standard for Entrapment Hazards in Bunk Beds, 16 C.F.R. Part 1513. Children can get their necks caught in the opening between the post and the decorative molding. Units: About 405.

title: Miami Breaker Recalls Counterfeit Square D Circuit Breakers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The recalled circuit breakers labeled "Square D" or "SQD" have been determined to be counterfeit by Square D and can fail to trip when they are overloaded, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 43,600.

title: Magnetic Maze Boards Recalled by Lakeshore Learning Materials Due to Choking, Intestinal and Aspiration Hazards
summary: The magnetic maze board's plastic wand can separate and expose a magnet that can be a choking hazard to children. Also, if a child has more than one of these toys and the magnets detach and are swallowed, the magnets can attract each other and cause intestinal perforations or blockages, which can be

title: Television Wall Mounts Recalled by Milestone AV Technologies Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The elbow joint components on the wall mount's arm do not fit together properly, causing the attached television to tilt and possibly fall when the television is adjusted. This could pose an injury hazard to a consumer. Units: About 131,000.

title: Baby Hammock Metal Stands Recalled by MamaLittleHelper Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The C-shaped metal stand can break where the curved arm attaches to the leg of the metal frame, posing a fall hazard to an infant in the hammock. Units: About 6.

title: Baby Hammocks Recalled by MamaLittleHelper Due to Suffocation Hazard
summary: The side-to-side shifting or tilting of the hammock can cause the infant to roll and become entrapped or wedged against the hammock's fabric and/or mattress pad, resulting in a suffocation hazard. Units: About 500.

title: Char-Broil Recalls Vertical Gas Smokers Due to Injury Hazard
summary: When the temperature setting is in "low," the smoker's hose/valve/regulator (HVR) assembly does not allow sufficient gas to flow, causing the flame to extinguish. Gas continues to flow and build up inside the smoker. If the smoker is reignited the build-up of propane gas can cause an explosion that

title: Williams-Sonoma Recalls Baby Bottle Warmers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The bottle warmers can overheat liquids and baby food, posing a burn hazard to adults and babies. Units: About 11,000.

title: Lan Enterprises Recalls Zooper Tango Double Strollers Due to Collapse Hazard
summary: The stroller's frame latch above the front wheels can fail when the stroller hits an object, causing the stroller to unexpectedly collapse. This can result in minor scrapes, cuts and bruises. Units: About 3,700.

title: White Tiger Outdoor Folding Chairs Recalled Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The wooden frame of the chairs can break, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 7,000.

title: Brigade Hickory Handle Sledge Hammers Recalled by White Cap Construction Supply Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The head of the sledge hammer can loosen and detach, posing a risk of impact injury to consumers. Units: About 15,000.

title: Electrical Wire Recalled by Cerro Wire due to Fire Hazard
summary: While the actual electrical wire has "14 gauge" printed on it, the packaging incorrectly labels the electrical wire as 12 gauge. If used as a 12 gauge wire, it can overload, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,000.

title: Powertec Recalls to Repair Leverage Gyms Due to Injury Hazard
summary: Detachment of the exercise workbench from the gym system causes instability, posing a risk of injury to consumers. Units: About 1,000.

title: 32-Inch Sharp LCD-TVs Recalled Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The TV stand's neck support can break and cause the TV to tip-over, posing a risk of injury to the consumer. Units: About 9,000.

title: Slow Cookers Recalled by Sensio Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Kohl's Department Stores
summary: The slow cooker's control panel can overheat and melt, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 25,000.
